title: Room to grow
description: Open and filled endpoints compare two readings, including decreases, ties and incomplete pairs.

props.name: data
props.description: Unique nonempty IDs, labels and signed before/after readings. Null and non-finite endpoints have no mark; available partners remain. A rail requires both endpoints. Ties show concentric circles; fully missing pairs keep a dash and inspection.

props.name: beforeLabel
props.description: Label for the small open endpoint; defaults to Before.

props.name: afterLabel
props.description: Label for the larger filled endpoint; defaults to After.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned measurement label; defaults to Value (Units for SoftGauge).

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats readings and tooltips; defaults to en-US numbers with at most two decimals.

props.name: width
props.description: Total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense categorical plots scroll locally when the supplied size cannot hold their data.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite native drawing using scoped motion tokens and live reduced-motion preference; defaults to true.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible title for the native chart.
